items.summary: Add a concise “How to add products” help section to the top of the /admin Product Management page that explains the exact steps an admin should take (login, open Admin/Manage Products, click “Add Product”, fill required fields, save), and clearly lists required fields (Product Name, Category, Description, Image URL, Affiliate URL) vs optional fields (Brand, Price).

Improve admin navigation labeling so admins can more easily find where to add products by renaming the header nav item currently labeled “Admin” to “Manage Products” (still routing to /admin) in both desktop and mobile navigation.

When a category page has no products and the current user is an admin, add a secondary call-to-action in the empty state (e.g., a button) that navigates directly to /admin to add the first product for that category.
